method: printed contents pp. vii-ix (pdf 6-8); MIT Press 1989 English translation (Burger/Lawrence), complete. Offset printed+21 = pdf, constant across the book; the 7 roman-numeral chapters (I-VII) and the 25 numbered sections (given here as '§N ...' so the planner treats them as sections, not chapters) were each located in the text cache at the expected page. Sections run on mid-page, so toc_check 'not found near top' warnings for level-1 entries are expected. Chapter 1 heading is on pdf 22 (pdf 20 = part half-title). Endnotes pdf 272-319, index pdf 320-322. The PDF's own outline (flat ~320 entries) was ignored. The Notes section (pdf 272) has no 'Notes' heading on the page (it opens with notes to the Preface), hence a harmless warning.
